T: The race that stops a nation.
D: The story of the champion racehorse who won the hearts of Depression-era Australia.
P: Serve the snacks when the Melbourne Cup starts.
S: Flemington Cup day beef party pies
Mini beef pies with puff lids, served with tomato sauce

Homemade little pies of peppery beef mince in rich gravy under a puff pastry lid, served hot with tomato sauce. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 diced onion. Stir in 2 tbsp plain flour, then 300ml beef stock, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and plenty of pepper and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Cool. Cut 12 bases from 2 sheets shortcrust pastry and press into a greased patty pan tin. Fill, top with 12 rounds of puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
Toasted baguette with chutney, vintage cheddar and red apple

Crisp toasts with vintage cheddar, thin apple slices, fruit chutney and a few thyme leaves, apples for Tommy and Big Red alike. Slice 1 baguette into 20 rounds, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes. Thinly slice 2 red apples and toss in lemon juice. Spread each toast with a little fruit chutney, top with a slice of 200g vintage cheddar and a slice of apple. Finish with thyme leaves and cracked pepper.
M: Big Red's Cup day roast beef rolls
Cold roast beef, caramelised onion, rocket, beetroot and horseradish cream

Soft rolls piled with rare roast beef, horseradish cream, caramelised onion, rocket and pickled beetroot, the grand picnic for Cup Day. Rub a 1kg beef eye fillet or rump with oil, salt and pepper, sear all over and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for rare. Rest and chill, then slice thinly. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Split 4 soft rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with beef, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.
Cup day picnic chicken and potato salad
Cold roast chook and egg and chive potato salad, on the rug at Flemington
Chicken roasted the day before and served cold in pieces, with a potato salad of egg, chives and mayonnaise.
W: Chocolate coconut sponge squares filled with jam and cream

Sponge squares split and filled with raspberry jam and cream, dipped in chocolate icing and rolled in coconut. Cut a 20cm square sponge cake into 16 squares and freeze 30 minutes. Mix 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g melted butter and 150ml boiling water into a thin icing. Dip each square in the icing, let it drip, then roll in 150g desiccated coconut. Set for 30 minutes. Split each in half and fill with raspberry jam and whipped cream from 200ml thickened cream.
K: Tequila, pink grapefruit and lime topped with soda, salted rim

Tequila and fresh pink grapefruit with lime and soda in a salt-rimmed glass. Leave out the tequila for a grapefruit spritz. Rub a lime wedge around the rims of 4 tall glasses and dip in sea salt. Fill with ice. Add 45ml tequila, 90ml pink grapefruit juice and the juice of half a lime to each glass. Top with 60ml soda water and stir gently. Garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

dishes.make_ahead: Roast the chicken and make the potato salad 1 day ahead; both are served cold

steps.text: Rub the chicken with oil and salt, put the halved lemon inside and roast at 200C until the juices run clear.
Boil the potatoes until tender with the eggs in for the first 10 minutes. Drain and cool.
Peel and chop the eggs and fold through the potatoes with the mayonnaise, mustard and chopped chives.
Chill the chicken, then cut into pieces and pack with the potato salad.

Whip the cream.
